title: Ilocos minimum wage workers to get P35-40 pay hike by Dec. 14
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Minimum wage earners in the Ilocos region will receive a daily wage increase of P35 to P40 starting Dec. 14, while domestic workers will also get a P450 monthly pay increase.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Minimum wage earners in the Ilocos region will receive a daily wage increase of P35 to P40 starting Dec. 14, while domestic workers will also get a P450 monthly pay increase. Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino announced the new wage adjustments on Wednesday, Nov. 25, following the approval of the wage orders
